intent_snapshot.goal: Meet S6 of docs/specs/drive-always-lanes.spec.md: rewrite the drive contracts so every new single-task drive entry, including a GitHub Initiative Child entry, goes through the single-task Lane path, with synchronous runtime supervision, gate delegation, checkout delivery, cleanup and the decision relay described, the Herdr/background facility table labeled batch-only, and in-place records enrolled earlier still resumable (Spec D10).

acceptance.assertion: plugins/immune-brain/dist/drive.md instructs that a new single-task drive entry calls start_unattended_batch with task_id as its first step and no longer instructs a new entry to call the enroll or imm_canary_enrollment tool or to implement the task in the Parent conversation; it keeps the Child entry's prerequisite and tracker checks, states that a TaskRecord enrolled in place before this change stays resumable until terminal, and states that the Executor role runs inside the Lane process. tests/unattended-contracts.test.ts and tests/explicit-phase-entry-run-contract.test.ts pin these statements and fail when the old new-entry enroll instruction returns.

plugins/immune-brain/dist/drive-batch.md has a single-task Lane section stating synchronous runtime supervision on every Host (including inside Herdr), one native gate, manual staged and auto fast-forward delivery with the overlap park, exit-proof cleanup with batch_lane_retained otherwise, and the Parent decision relay; its supervised-session table and the Herdr Lane Tabs section are labeled as Initiative batch behavior. The named contract tests pin these statements.

attestations.summary: Tier low: contract prose (dist/drive.md, dist/drive-batch.md, drive SKILL.md) plus the contract tests that pin it. No runtime code, migration or persisted shape. DAL-S6-A1 and A2 are satisfied as written. drive.md routes a new single-task entry, Child entry included, to start_unattended_batch with task_id first, and drops the enroll and imm_canary_enrollment instruction and Parent-side implementation. It keeps the tracker and prerequisite checks, the drain-only in-place record statement and the Executor-in-Lane statement. drive-batch.md adds a Single-Task Lane section covering synchronous supervision including Herdr, one native gate, manual and auto delivery with the overlap park, exit-proof cleanup with batch_lane_retained, and the decision relay. The supervised-session table and Herdr Lane Tabs section are labeled batch-only. Tests assert each statement and the negative old-instruction strings, and the Kernel QA outcomes for both acceptances passed. The SKILL.md edit is outside scope_hint but disclosed as beyond_estimate, and it is needed to keep the loader consistent with the tests.
